tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background, header, tabs bar and sidebars (Zensical's modern layout keeps them on one ground). In light, the warm grey of sunlit clouds over a tarn (never white, never blue); in dark, an ink-blue night.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, table header rows, footer. One step away from `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Search results panel, tooltips, annotation popovers. Pair with `shadow-overlay`.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover background for navigation rows, table rows and icon buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers: header and tabs bottom edge, table cell borders, admonition outline. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: search field, secondary button, checkbox. At least 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `surface-raised` and every `*-tint`. In dark, a sunlit-cloud grey rather than white: about 13:1 on `surface`, softer on the eyes than near-white.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: navigation items, tabs, table of contents, captions, admonition body. On every surface and tint.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Metadata and secondary sections: breadcrumbs, dates, line numbers, placeholder text, the About/Contributing tabs. On `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Links, active navigation item, primary button fill, How-to guide marker. Text on `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `brand-tint`.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered and pressed links and buttons. Text on `surface` and `brand-tint`.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Active navigation row, text selection, info admonition fill.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` or `brand-strong` fill (primary button).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Nature green: Tutorial marker, tip and success admonitions. Text on `surface`, `surface-sunken` and `accent-tint`. Never for links.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of tip and success admonitions and the Tutorial badge.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: dtx-tutorial
tokens.usage: Diátaxis Tutorial marker (learning): badge text, tab dot and active-tab underline. Text on `dtx-tutorial-tint`.

tokens.name: dtx-tutorial-tint
tokens.usage: Tutorial badge fill.

tokens.name: dtx-howto
tokens.usage: Diátaxis How-to guide marker (tasks): badge text, tab dot and active-tab underline. Text on `dtx-howto-tint`.

tokens.name: dtx-howto-tint
tokens.usage: How-to badge fill.

tokens.name: dtx-reference
tokens.usage: Diátaxis Reference marker (information), deliberately neutral slate: badge text, tab dot and active-tab underline. Text on `dtx-reference-tint` and `surface`.

tokens.name: dtx-reference-tint
tokens.usage: Reference badge fill.

tokens.name: dtx-explanation
tokens.usage: Diátaxis Explanation marker (understanding), ochre: badge text, tab dot and active-tab underline. Text on `dtx-explanation-tint` and `surface`.

tokens.name: dtx-explanation-tint
tokens.usage: Explanation badge fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: note, info, abstract admonitions: icon and title. Text on `info-tint`.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of note, info, abstract admonitions.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: tip, success admonitions: icon and title. Text on `success-tint`.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of tip, success admonitions.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: warning, question admonitions: icon and title. Text on `warning-tint` and `surface`.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of warning, question admonitions.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: danger, failure, bug admonitions: icon and title. Text on `danger-tint` and `surface`. Always paired with an icon and a title word.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of danger, failure, bug admonitions.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: example, quote admonitions and blockquote rule.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of example and quote admonitions.

tokens.name: logo-tile
tokens.usage: Tile fill for Tarn's logo and the example flow logo, identical in both themes: 5.7:1 behind a white glyph, at least 3:1 against `surface` and `surface-sunken` in both themes. The SVG exports store this value directly.

tokens.name: logo-glyph
tokens.usage: Glyph colour in Tarn's logo and the example flow logo, drawn on `logo-tile` and identical in both themes.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Highlighted text (==mark==) background; text stays `ink`.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block background.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Plain code text, identifiers, punctuation. On `code-bg`.

tokens.name: code-inline-bg
tokens.usage: Inline code background (class names, options, values inside a sentence). Darker than `code-bg` so it stands out on `surface`.

tokens.name: code-inline-ink
tokens.usage: Inline code text: a plum that no other text uses, so code names stand out from prose and from blue links. On `code-inline-bg` and every admonition tint. Inside a link, inline code takes the link colour.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords (def, return, import). On `code-bg` and `code-hl`.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings and docstrings. On `code-bg` and `code-hl`.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, constants, booleans. On `code-bg` and `code-hl`.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Function and class names. On `code-bg` and `code-hl`.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, set italic. On `code-bg` and `code-hl`.

tokens.name: code-operator
tokens.usage: Operators. On `code-bg`.

tokens.name: code-hl
tokens.usage: Highlighted line background (hl_lines), with a 2px `brand` bar on its left edge.

families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Section heading (h2). Gets a `line` hairline above it on long pages.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Minor heading (h4). Deeper levels are a sign the page should be split.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Run the command, then check that the service answers on port 8080.
styles.usage: All running text, lists, table cells. `ink` on `surface`.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Do not run this on a production database.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Navigation, table of contents, tabs, buttons, search.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels only: Diátaxis badge, navigation section headers.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks. Inline code uses 0.875em of the surrounding text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, inline code padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Navigation row vertical padding, badge padding, tab gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Admonition title padding, table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Code block padding, admonition body padding, paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between content blocks (code, admonition, table) and the text around them.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above h2 headings; sidebar gutters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above the page footer and between major page regions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, kbd, badges, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks, admonitions, buttons, search field, tabs container.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Search results panel, logo tile (at 24px), cards on landing pages.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The only shadow: floating layers (search results, tooltips, annotation popovers). Everything on the page itself is flat, separated by `line`.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text (about 75 characters). Code blocks and tables may use the full content column.

tokens.name: rule-width
tokens.usage: Every hairline: header edge, table borders, admonition outline.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring thickness and offset.
